Block elements treated as inline

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"convert_as_inline\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>One</p><p>Two</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content())
```
